name: editor-ui-fixes
description: Verify editor UI interaction fixes: catalog as a left sidebar, light brightness slider styling, and the tick/cross confirmation bar.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s=window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-items
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; s.setItems([{id:'lamp1',defId:'floor-lamp',position:[cx,cz],rotation:0,props:{}},{id:'sofa1',defId:'sofa-3seat',position:[cx-1,cz+1],rotation:0,props:{}}]); })()
